# PDL Portfolio OS (v2) - Machine Discovery & LLM Interface
> A production-grade frontend-first portfolio management operating system for Prajwal DL (SILVERSTEN).

## System Architecture
- **Framework**: React 19, TypeScript 5+, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 3
- **Graphics**: Three.js WebGL spatial engines with 2D fallbacks
- **State Management**: Reactive in-memory / local storage publisher with instant UI synchronization
- **Routing**: Client-side hash/path router supporting deep linking

## Public Routes
- `/`: Isolated Theme Home page (renders currently active theme from the 19 distinct worlds)
- `/projects`: Production systems catalog with search, tech stack filtering, and case study modal triggers
- `/projects/:id`: Comprehensive project case study detailing Problem, Architecture, Technologies, and Metrics
- `/blog`: Editorial essays and technical publications
- `/blog/:slug`: Full article view with reading progress bar, table of contents, and interactive comments
- `/about`: Professional engineering biography and architectural tenets
- `/experience`: Chronological career timeline and achievements
- `/skills`: Categorized skill radar with mastery indicators
- `/resume`: Interactive recruiter resume with PDF print route (`/resume/print`)
- `/contact`: Direct communication portal and availability status
- `/search`: Global full-text search across projects, essays, and skills
- `/rss.xml`: Content syndication feed preview

## 19 Structurally Distinct Themes
1. `theme-01-minimal-editorial`: Magazine-style asymmetric grid with side hover preview rail
2. `theme-02-brutalist`: High-contrast black/amber monospace brutalism with ticker marquee
3. `theme-03-cyberpunk-hud`: Sci-fi holographic heads-up display with neon overlays
4. `theme-04-terminal-cli`: Interactive MS-DOS/bash terminal interface with runnable commands
5. `theme-05-galaxy-cosmos-3d`: Three.js WebGL 3D particle cosmos background with orbit controls
6. `theme-06-bento-showcase`: Apple-style modular bento grid with live metric cards
7. `theme-07-noir-aurora`: Dark ambient northern lights aurora glows with fluid glassmorphism
8. `theme-08-bauhaus-modernist`: Geometric constructivist shapes (circles, triangles, bold primary colors)
9. `theme-09-retro-desktop-os`: 90s desktop operating system with draggable windows, start menu, and taskbar
10. `theme-10-horizontal-scrolly`: Side-scrolling panoramic architectural timeline
11. `theme-11-kinetic-physics-3d`: Interactive 3D physics floating typography and canvas
12. `theme-12-blueprint-drafting`: Cyanotype architectural blueprint with technical drafting grids
13. `theme-13-swiss-typographic`: International typographic style with strict baseline grid
14. `theme-14-split-screen`: Dual-column independent scrolling with interactive pinned view
15. `theme-15-neumorphic-soft`: Soft tactile clay/neumorphic surfaces with debossed and embossed highlights
16. `theme-16-holographic-matrix`: Green phosphor digital rain with matrix cascade overlays
17. `theme-17-newspaper-broadside`: Classic broadsheet newspaper layout with multi-column serif text
18. `theme-18-spatial-canvas`: Three.js interactive 3D spatial node graph with rotatable camera
19. `theme-19-prajwal-luxury`: Obsidian black and bullion gold haute couture typography

## Admin Operating System (`/admin`)
- `/admin/dashboard`: Executive control center with health radar, publishing lifecycle, and quick actions
- `/admin/visual-editor`: Professional 3-column visual site builder with multi-viewport responsive preview
- `/admin/settings`: Grouped settings architecture with 16 dedicated category sections
- `/admin/design-system`: Real-time token studio for colors, typography, radius, shadows, and live component previews
- `/admin/themes`: Full-screen theme switcher & visual gallery
- `/admin/projects`: Project CMS with cover manager and tech stack selector
- `/admin/blog`: Markdown blog editor with live preview and reading time calculation
- `/admin/automations`: LinkedIn and social post queue with Telegram approval workflows
- `/admin/analytics`: Real-time traffic, recruiter sessions, and pageview intelligence
- `/admin/seo`: OpenGraph social card previews, SERP preview, and sitemap generator
- `/admin/recruiter`: Recruiter-optimized high-density resume and portfolio mode
- `/admin/media`: Asset library with upload, search, tag, and storage quota indicators
- `/admin/backup`: One-click JSON data export, migration, and restore engine

## Automated Agent & Testing Compatibility
- All interactive controls contain explicit `data-testid` and `aria-label` attributes for automated browser testing.
- No blocking paywalls, registration gates, or CAPTCHA obstructions exist in the evaluation flow.
